messages:
jess: FYI customer ACME (proj: acme-prod) opened a ticket — they got repeated 429s (rate_limit_exceeded) at ~2025-09-12T15:20:00Z while the project quota dashboard shows they're at ~44% of daily token quota. They say this started after a spike of short requests.

jess: Repro steps sent by customer:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-3b","input":"ping","max_tokens":8}'
```
They included the API response: `{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":7}` and header dump showing `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `x-rate-limit-reset: 1694575200`.

devon: Can you attach the raw request IDs? That reset value looks like a unix epoch for a rolling window reset. If their dashboard aggregates by workspace or org, counts might be higher than per-project.

jess: I have the request IDs and the customer's workspace id. They claim only acme-prod used tokens during the window. Customer also attached our dashboard screenshot showing per-project bar at 44% and the global workspace line at 102% (they said this is surprising).

maria: Billing loop: dashboards are derived from streaming metering events, invoices use aggregated daily totals. Quotas/rate-limits are enforced by the rate-limiter which uses a sliding window keyed by (org_id, project_id, api_key) depending on config. Need to check whether this customer has workspace-level aggregation enabled accidentally.

ana: (note: I'm ana from Platform Eng) I dug into the rate-limiter config for acme org. The runtime rollout last week changed default keying to include organization_id when the feature flag `rl.aggregate_by_workspace` is true — intended for teams who want workspace-level caps. It looks like ACME's org flag flipped during a config sync on 2025-09-12 15:05 UTC. That would explain rate-limit enforcement at workspace level while the project dashboard still shows per-project filters.

devon: Oof. So the UI hasn't backfilled or annotated the dashboard to show that rollout. The enforcement is correct per the current config; the dashboard aggregation window uses precomputed daily rollups and will display per-project if the query param is set. But the customer was looking at a per-project view while enforcement used workspace keying.

jess: Customer impact: 4x 429 spikes over 7 minutes; they had a minute of degraded UX on a live demo. They want immediate mitigation + explanation and an internal RCA.

ana: Short-term mitigation: toggle `rl.aggregate_by_workspace` back for ACME, or add an exception mapping their project_id to the per-project limiter. I can patch config to revert for ACME quickly. Long term: we need UI changes to surface active rate-limit keying and a backfill job to reconcile dashboard state with enforcement keys.

maria: I'll also verify metering events for discrepancies between token counts in streaming events vs daily aggregates that feed billing. If we changed keying mid-window, counts might be double-counted in some rollups.

ops-billing-bot: Created ticket RBW-3247 linked to billing-systems: Investigate aggregation & reconciliation for acme org (assigned to maria).

devon: For engineering/debug: can someone paste a sample request_id and the relevant limiter logs? We need to correlate x-rate-limit-* headers to limiter state.

jess: Pasting one request id from customer: r-0a3f9b2c. Attached limiter excerpt: `limiter[acme-org][workspace]: token_count=102345 reset_at=1694575200 window=86400`.

ana: That matches the config flip. I'll roll back the flag for acme-org and redeploy the limiter config to the runtime in the next 6 minutes. After rollback they'll hit per-project caps again (which matches their dashboard).

jess: Noted. I'll message the customer with temporary workaround: retry-after handling + we'll revert config and confirm when done.

maria: Follow-up: I'm running reconciliation to ensure billing totals not inflated. If any duplicated aggregation happened between 15:00-16:00 UTC we'll need to correct analytics and notify finance.

devon: After ana's rollback let's collect traces for a 30m window and add a small dashboard note for acme org: "rate-limiter keying: project-level". Also add an audit entry to the org config history.

jess: Customer update sent: we found a config change that temporarily switched quota enforcement to workspace level. We're reverting now and will follow up with a timeline + RCA. They asked for a credit if billing was affected. Tagged @maria for billing follow-up. :pray:

ana: Rollback complete — limiter config reverted for acme-org at 2025-09-12T15:27:15Z. I see successful responses resume in logs.

jess: Confirmed with customer — no more 429s after ~15:28 UTC. They appreciated the quick turnaround.

maria: I'll update RBW-3247 with reconciliation results and follow up on credit. Will notify finance if invoice adjustments required.

devon: Action items: (1) add UI indicator for active limiter keying, (2) ensure feature-flag rollout includes dashboard backfill or warning, (3) add an automatic reconcile job when keying changes mid-window.

jess: Thanks team. Closing the immediate support loop. Will keep RBW-3247 open for billing/analytics work.
